results.title: Saving Cattle Carl | PHOTOS
results.description: A GoFundMe effort has raised more than $23,000 to purchase Carl, a 1,400-pound, 2 1/2-year-old Charolais steer raised at Kinder Farm Park by 17-year-old 4-H member Madison Cassady, at the Anne Arundel County Fair auction and send him to a petting zoo rather than a meat processor.
